definitions.gloss: to witness; to see (an event) happen
definitions.explanation: To see something happen with one's own eyes, especially an incident, accident, or crime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目撃|もくげき}した。
⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目撃|もくげき}した⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧はいます⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Is there anyone who witnessed the moment of the crime?

examples.japanese: ⟦{通行人|つうこうにん}→通行人：28570_tsuukounin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目撃|もくげき}して、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通報|つうほう}→通報：14318_tsuuhou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A passerby witnessed the car collision and immediately reported it to the police.

notes:
Literally "to strike the eye" — composed of {目|もく} (eye) + {撃|げき} (strike, hit). Used for personally seeing an incident, crime, or noteworthy event. Carries a stronger nuance than simply "seeing" — implies the event is significant or unexpected.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目撃|もくげき}する: to witness an accident
- ⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目撃|もくげき}する: to witness a crime
- ⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{目撃|もくげき}する: to witness the scene
- ⟦{目撃者|もくげきしゃ}→目撃者：09652_mokugekisha⟧: eyewitness
- ⟦{目撃|もくげき}→目撃：13627_mokugeki⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: eyewitness information
- ⟦{目撃|もくげき}→目撃：13627_mokugeki⟧⟦{証言|しょうげん}→証言：11088_shougen⟧: eyewitness testimony

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to see, to look — general-purpose word with no connotation of incidents
- ⟦{目|ま}の{当|あ}たり→目の当たり：13743_manoatari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to witness firsthand — emphasizes emotional impact of seeing something up close
